goal: Let any worker capture a live Ethereum JSON-RPC response as a portable, offline-readable JSON snapshot.
Let any worker check a JSON deliverable against an explicit structural contract and locate every violation offline.
Let any worker verify that an Ethereum transaction succeeded, remains canonical, and meets a settlement policy before relying on its outcome.
Let any worker independently calculate and check an EIP-712 typed-data digest offline before trusting a signing request.
